leverage.note: UK fees page states maximum leverage 1:30. It does not publish a separate professional cap.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: UK account and fees page states minimum deposit 0 GBP and also 'No minimum deposit'. Opening an account is free. Enough money is still required to meet margin for a trade.

other_fees.label: XTB deposit and withdrawal fees
other_fees.note: XTB does not charge deposit fees. Payment providers or the client's bank may charge. Withdrawals are free. XTB processes withdrawals within up to 3 business days.

other_fees.label: Account opening and maintenance
other_fees.note: Free for all active clients, regardless of account balance.

other_fees.label: FSCS
other_fees.note: Regulation page: eligible clients may be able to claim up to 120,000 GBP if the firm cannot meet its obligations. Homepage also shows 120,000 GBP FSCS money protection.

_notes.fetch_notes: Fetched on 2026-10-11. The fees page did not name a platform product such as xStation, only mobile, desktop and tablet. The help page says EU residents are onboarded with an entity it also calls XTB Limited, regulated by CySEC, but it gives no CySEC licence number. Non-EU and non-UK residents are onboarded with XTB International Limited, IFSC Belize licence 6442514. An older education article found in search said FSCS cover of 85,000 GBP; the fetched regulation page and homepage say 120,000 GBP, so 120,000 GBP is the figure used. Homepage retail CFD loss rate was not in the homepage extract; the regulation page says 72%.
_notes.company_details_not_listed: XTB Limited, company number 07227848. FCA firm reference number 522157. Registered address Level 9, One Canada Square, Canary Wharf, London, E14 5AA. The regulation page says XTB is listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange and has operated for over 20 years.
